text: I had a wisdom tooth extraction and dental scaling here. The dentist and staff were very kind and gentle. Everything went smoothly and almost painless. Highly recommend 👍🏻 …

Terrible. The retainers are ill-fitting, there's no adjustment, and they don't listen to the patient. My gums are swollen and infected with pus all over my mouth. The doctor recommended extraction as the only option, as if I've already paid in full and they don't want to care for or take responsibility, just rushing me to get extracted to avoid responsibility. Absolutely awful. They don't listen to the patient at all, they just cut off customers. I'm so disappointed, especially since my family has been using their services for 10 years, starting with the old, ill-mannered assistant at the counter, then getting negative reviews, and only recently receiving positive feedback. Now my teeth are loose and my gums are retracted everywhere. Think carefully, most of the positive reviews are probably from people within the organization writing amongst themselves.

The dentist was incredibly gentle! The wisdom tooth extraction took less than 10 minutes. The dentist was lovely, the assistant was kind, it was easy to get there, and most importantly, the price was good. I highly recommend it to anyone who's considering it! ✨

text: Affordable dental clinic, good work, clean, helpful advice. Social security insurance accepted (no upfront payment required, 900 baht). The dentist is very patient. Coming back at the end of the month for fillings – very reasonable prices! Recommended to make an appointment before visiting.
As an outpatient, I went to the dentist to have my orthodontic wires trimmed, and the dentist didn't charge me for cutting them short.
